decision: Substantive weak coverage: distinguish offline viewing or local edits from a change reaching others. Improve existing sync guide rather than create another generic calendar page.

queries.queryLimitations: First query literally used site.support rather than site: and therefore was not a reliable domain restriction. Combined output does not reliably attribute each result to a query. No Google ranking measurement.
queries.unreadStatus: Troubleshooting and supported-browser URLs discovered only, not primary evidence adopted. Search response truncated; this is selected observed results, not exhaustive result capture.

currentCoverage.inventory: inventory.json:58 current English definitions screened by slug; not all58 bodies reread

comparisons.scope: Complete object including all7sections, practical, FAQ, sources, related and metadata
comparisons.alreadyCovered: Account ownership, connection types, disposable two-device test, network-dependent sync, selection side effects and avoiding destructive reconnect.
comparisons.missing: No explicit offline preflight or distinction between seeing a locally saved edit and recipients receiving it. No provider app versus mobile browser distinction.

comparisons.alreadyCovered: PDF snapshot, ICS copy versus feed, backup verification and Google ownership transfer.
comparisons.missing: Itinerary example useful fallback but no offline-change workflow. Reuse existing export route rather than duplicate instructions.

comparisons.alreadyCovered: Disconnect attempts can remove mirrors; preserve needed information and avoid first-step account deletion.
comparisons.missing: Not a guide to temporary loss of connectivity. Signing out must not be suggested as offline preparation.

recommendedAction.type: One meaningful section within existing sync guide, not new canonical
recommendedAction.suggestedHeading: Before using your calendar without a connection
contentPlan: Before travel or weak connectivity, identify the exact app/account and verify the needed dates while online. Keep a readable dated itinerary if appropriate using existing export guidance.
Attribute Google iPhone app offline support explicitly; explain online initial setup and later synchronization, and distinguish Google mobile-browser editing limits.
Use a disposable owned event without guests to check the actual app/account rather than a real meeting. Do not infer offline queue or conflict handling from merely seeing old events.
After reconnecting, verify the event at the owning provider before treating a meeting change as delivered. Do not promise background immediacy or guest responses.
recommendedAction.productGate: Before making ANY Cloud-specific offline editing, queued-write, history retention or retry promise, obtain targeted native evidence and appropriate validation. This research establishes none. A provider-attributed section can remain useful without those claims.
recommendedAction.scenario: A traveler changes tomorrow’s appointment during a flight. Seeing the changed time on that phone is not confirmation that the organizer or other participants received it.

limits: Evidence establishes publisher topics and provider workflow, not demand size, rankings, ChatGPT citations or exhaustive keyword coverage.
No customer data, native app or browser-account operations performed.
No new page justified by the offline keyword alone.
